card.text: Explore Gaspra in 3D with cssEarth using archived spacecraft imagery and source-backed shape data.

introduction.text: Galileo photographed Gaspra in 1991, making it the first asteroid visited by a spacecraft.

normal.title: SSI monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Photographed shadows and seams remain after mapping the images onto the shape. The gray grid marks poor or missing data.

calibrated.title: Calibrated Galileo photographs
calibrated.summary: These Galileo close-ups cover opposite ends of Gaspra. They were taken through a clear filter and show the sunlight and shadows from the flyby. The grid marks areas without usable photographs.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 6.1 km sphere, including Gaspra's broad shape. The unseen side is less certain.
